criteria.given_when: Existing entry points and fixed legacy fixtures run.
criteria.required_evidence: Historical scores/intermediates and seeded legacy outputs are preserved in the pinned environment; intentional nonlegacy differences are separately versioned.

criteria.given_when: E1 samples one cohort at 5/15/30/60 minutes.
criteria.required_evidence: Latent/support/episode identities match; shared sampled times have identical underlying and noise values.

criteria.given_when: A constant 96% background has one 5-point episode lasting 30 minutes.
criteria.required_evidence: Latent values are 91% during that interval and 96% outside it at every observation schedule; no accumulated decrement.

criteria.given_when: Long unclipped AR background, no desaturations.
criteria.required_evidence: Empirical marginal SD and correlation at fixed elapsed lags agree with declared values within prespecified stochastic tolerances, not tolerances tuned after failure.

criteria.given_when: Conditions reordered/isolated/extended; chunks changed; N increased.
criteria.required_evidence: Same patient-condition rows remain identical; first 200 patients do not change in a 1,000-patient run.

criteria.given_when: Noise, missingness, or threshold factor changes in fixed-support mode.
criteria.required_evidence: Latent oxygenation and support/FiO2 are unchanged. A separate stress mode explicitly permits assignment changes.

criteria.given_when: Identical FiO2 moves between set/measured columns with no conflicts.
criteria.required_evidence: Provenance changes but all numerical scores and P/F values remain identical.

criteria.given_when: All FiO2 evidence is removed in a designated non-room-air fixture.
criteria.required_evidence: No hidden latent value, surviving flow/room-air fallback, or adapter artifact supplies it; eligibility follows the documented profile.

criteria.given_when: All oxygenation evidence is missing; compare with observed normal data and a suppressed abnormal singleton.
criteria.required_evidence: Three distinct statuses; old algorithm zeros preserved; tables reconcile without calling no-data records normal.

criteria.given_when: Two records, SpO2=96, room air, no measured PaO2, at t=0 and +15min.
criteria.required_evidence: Conversion PaO2=81.9 and P/F=390.00 unchanged across factors; algorithm score 1 at factor 1.0 and 0 at .85.

criteria.given_when: Same two-record fixture has measured PaO2=84 at both times.
criteria.required_evidence: Measured-first P/F=400.00 and score 0 at factor 1.0; exact threshold ties use the implemented strict inequalities.

criteria.given_when: SpO2 49,50,96,97 without measured PaO2.
criteria.required_evidence: Conversion unavailable at 49/97, available at 50/96. UI represents unavailable explicitly; no high-saturation PaO2 is fabricated.

criteria.given_when: One low-flow record: SpO2=90, flow=4 L/min, factor=1.0. Then add an identical record 15min later.
criteria.required_evidence: Inferred FiO2=33%, P/F=177.88, presuppression score 2; legacy singleton reported 0 with suppression, two records reported 2.

criteria.given_when: HFNC, NIPPV, IMV, SURG IMV fixtures exercise both support gates.
criteria.required_evidence: Legacy behavior retained. Named support ablation changes all relevant gates, with an event-level explanation.

criteria.given_when: FiO2 context at exact and just-outside 1/5/14-minute and 24-hour boundaries; conflicting current/previous values.
criteria.required_evidence: Source event IDs and chosen priority match the versioned rule; no future unavailable evidence in as-of mode.

criteria.given_when: Admit at 12:37, target endpoints, midnight and DST boundaries.
criteria.required_evidence: v2 acute membership is explicit and bounded; calendar versus admission bins demonstrably differ when expected; legacy fixture results remain unchanged.

criteria.given_when: Separate observation and documentation streams with duplicate or coincident timestamps.
criteria.required_evidence: No Cartesian joins or duplicated P/F counts. Distinct genuine measurements remain distinct; ties use stable event IDs.

criteria.given_when: Exact replay baseline/acute control with matching exposure and equivalent scoring rules.
criteria.required_evidence: Signed/evaluable delta is exactly zero. Independent stationary realizations are not falsely constrained to zero.

criteria.given_when: Binomial counts k=0 and k=N.
criteria.required_evidence: Wilson intervals have valid nonzero uncertainty width unless structural identity is explicitly proven elsewhere.

criteria.given_when: Paired binary table has n_plus=30, n_minus=10, N=100.
criteria.required_evidence: Difference is 0.20 = 20 percentage points; sample MCSE is sqrt((40-100*.2**2)/(99*100)); interval uses paired discordance counts.

criteria.given_when: No observed discordances between nonidentical stochastic conditions.
criteria.required_evidence: Observed MCSE may be zero, but reported boundary-safe interval is not asserted to prove equality.

criteria.given_when: Threshold probability, mean count .5, paired change -.02, and an unscorable cell render.
criteria.required_evidence: Display 50%, 0.5 records, -2 percentage points, and U/not evaluable respectively; no magnitude-based unit guessing.

criteria.given_when: User edits a base scenario then expands a sweep or changes controls after a run.
criteria.required_evidence: Sweep inherits the actual base. Old results are marked stale and exports retain their original immutable request.

criteria.given_when: User selects a transition cell and a patient.
criteria.required_evidence: Trace score matches the summary; explanations identify actual determining/excluded evidence without rerunning the cohort.

criteria.given_when: Export/import/reproduce in a clean pinned environment.
criteria.required_evidence: Scientific tables match, hashes validate, schema/versions preserved; unsupported versions produce actionable errors.

criteria.given_when: Same small fixtures run natively and through actual Pyodide.
criteria.required_evidence: Exact discrete outputs and matching floats within predeclared tolerances; this is not replaced by a Python-only contract test.

criteria.given_when: Every advertised control/variant is exercised by a relevant fixture.
criteria.required_evidence: It affects the claimed mechanism or is explicitly documented as provenance-only/inactive; no dead controls or hidden default resets.

criteria.given_when: Six named experiments and deterministic explorer complete.
criteria.required_evidence: Real output tables, configurations, selected traces, plots, and a findings/limitations note exist. No invented positive findings.
